# tcs-render-lesson

Renders a lesson's storyboard.json / quiz.json / curriculum.yaml into the NON-VIDEO deliverables — an interactive HTML lesson (branching, knowledge checks, screencast sims), a narrated deck (PPTX with speaker notes + HTML slides), a SCORM 1.2 package for an LMS (e.g. Tandrik), and a printable PDF job aid (A4/Letter).

Part of the **[Training Content Studio](../training-content-studio/README.md)** plugin.

## What it's for
Turn finished, validated lesson data into deliverables learners and LMSs can use, with **no new text**: every visible
string comes from storyboard props, quiz items or curriculum titles (UI chrome labels like Next/Back come from a fixed
EN/AR table). No generated images with text; icons are inline SVG; personas are SVG (kit art if present, else neutral
placeholders in the persona palette from `assets/characters/personas.yaml`).

## When to use it
- Use for targets lesson, deck, scorm or jobaid, or when asked to "export to SCORM", "make slides/PPTX", "build the e-learning page", "print a cheat sheet".
- **Not for:** MP4/video renders (tcs-render-remotion / tcs-render-openmontage) and not for writing or changing content (tcs-storyboard, tcs-assessment, tcs-format-*).

## Install
```bash
# whole plugin (recommended: scripts use the shared schemas/, kit/, assets/)
git clone https://github.com/TamerElsherif/tamer-skills && claude --plugin-dir tamer-skills/training-content-studio
# this skill only (instructions only; its scripts need the plugin root)
npx skills add TamerElsherif/tamer-skills --skill tcs-render-lesson --agent claude-code
```
Prerequisites: Python 3.12 venv with `tools/requirements.txt` (plugin root); keys via env or `TCS_ENV_FILE` (`OPENAI_API_KEY` for narration/transcription, `PEXELS_API_KEY` optional); Node 18+ and ffmpeg for video renders.

## How to use
```
/tcs-render-lesson <request or file>
```
**Inputs**

| File | Used by |
|---|---|
| `<L>.storyboard.json` (schemas/storyboard.schema.json) | all |
| `<L>.quiz.json` (schemas/quiz.schema.json) — optional | lesson, deck notes, SCORM score |
| `curriculum.yaml` (schemas/curriculum.schema.json) | SCORM organisation |
| `jobaid.yaml` (references/jobaid-yaml.md) — optional | jobaid |
| `audio/<scene_id>.mp3|m4a|wav` next to the storyboard — optional | lesson (player + captions), deck (embedded) |

Every script accepts **a file or a run folder** (`runs/<id>/`, see `skills/tcs-orchestrator/references/run-layout.md`);
with a run folder, `--lesson M1L1` and `--lang ar-EG` select files, and outputs default to the run layout.

**Outputs**

| Target | Output |
|---|---|
| lesson | `renders/<L>/lesson/index.html` (self-contained, CSS/JS inline) + `media/` + `lesson.json` |
| deck | `renders/<L>/deck/<L>.pptx` + `deck.html` |
| jobaid | `renders/<L>/jobaid/<L>.pdf` (+ `.html`, `.png` preview) |
| scorm | `renders/course/scorm/<course-id>-scorm12.zip` (one SCO per lesson) |
| missing dependency | `RENDER_PENDING.md` in the target folder with exact commands — never a hard failure |

## Examples
**Example 1: SCORM for the LMS**
Prompt: `export the course as SCORM 1.2 for Tandrik`
Result: Builds HTML lessons (branching, knowledge checks, sims) and packages one SCO per lesson; scorm_check validates it.

**Example 2: Deck + job aid**
Prompt: `make the PPTX deck and a one-page cheat sheet`
Result: PPTX with speaker notes + HTML slides; A4 PDF job aid via headless Chrome.
